newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai's Jan-May gold imports up 85.7 pct - WGC.
newsitem.headline: Dubai's Jan-May gold imports up 85.7 pct - WGC.

text.p: Dubai's gold imports in the first five months of this year reached 261.627 tonnes, an increase of over 85 percent on the same period last year, the World Gold Council (WGC) said on Thursday.

"The total imports (so far) in calendar year 1997 are an increase of 85.7 percent over that in the same period last year. In the period January to May 1996, 140.88 tonnes of gold were imported into Dubai," the WGC Dubai office said in a statement.
It put May's imports at 52.299 tonnes, up on the 33.282 tonnes imported in May 1996.

It said Switzerland was the main supplier so far this year, accounting for 69 percent of Dubai's imports. It exported 180.355 tonnes in the January-May period. Britain came second with exports so far at 60.566 tonnes.

The statement said South Africa has seen "phenomenal growth in the past two years" in its exports to Dubai. It exported 13.939 tonnes until May this year, exceeding the 13.411 tonnes for the whole of 1996.
Most of Dubai's imports are destined to the Indian subcontinent and particularly India -- the world's single biggest market for gold.
The WGC is a non-profit association owned by major gold producers and monitors about 75 percent of the world's markets.
